inputs.folder: One bounded pool of readers for the whole tree instead of re-checking every parent folder per file, which took 26% of load time. Cost: gains are uneven, with a 5,000-request folder opening in 3.1 to 12.9 s across six runs on a busy laptop.
run.sandbox: A fresh goja runtime per script instead of one shared runtime, because imported Postman and Bruno scripts are untrusted. Cost: booting one per script made a 400-request run take 3.9 s, until up to four pre-booted spares brought it to 1.2 s.
